bankShelfCarrier.mechanics: Each finite full-width shelf is an ideal fixed-root Euler–Bernoulli plate strip, with actual signed point force at the pipe axis and exact uniform shelf selfweight. The gross section combines maximum bending and rectangular shear as a conservative comparison. Core wrenches add shelf/backplate gravity once. Actual local plate/clamp contact, welds, prying, rod group, masonry and intermediate flexibility remain unsolved.
bankShelfCarrier.sourceActionScope: Each pickup receives the complete source branch signed pressure/locked-thermal challenge separately. Above/below pickup cases are NONCONCURRENT alternative load-path challenges, never four simultaneous branch forces. Nominal valve/tail gravity is already in the source force and is not added again.
bankShelfCarrier.gravityScope: Four manufactured shelves and backplates are distinct real stock. Clamps, rods/sleeves, weld stock, closures/insulation and complete handling payload remain unweighed.
bankShelfCarrier.decision: Reject the thin flat shelf as the current complete pressure/thermal carrier. Do not relieve the locked source demand by assuming sliding clamps. Develop a finite deeper/side receiver and solve actual flexibility, or revise the bank/tails with their complete occupied interfaces.
